name: Burn Resistance
body:
Price +10,000 gp; Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot armor quality; Weight —

DESCRIPTION

Armor with this special ability allows the wearer to ignore the nonlethal damage from up to 1 point of burn from which they are currently suffering. This ability can only be applied to armor.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 5,000 gp; Burn Resistance, Craft Magic Arms and Armor, kineticist 7th
